workers_max_history: Bumped 1→2 mid-deploy to clear the hung unhealthy pod from the CRLF-bug build, then restored to 1.
image_status: VERIFIED — ephemeral ttl.sh tag, expires ~2026-04-26 10:14 UTC. For permanent deployment, see deploy/DEPLOY.md (push to GHCR / Docker Hub / ECR and `runpodctl template update 4we83sqxqn --image <tag>`).
fixes_applied_during_m4: Dockerfile: `RUN sed -i 's/\r$//' /app/start.sh` to strip Windows CRLF that caused `/usr/bin/env: 'bash\r': No such file or directory` and made the worker exit immediately (RunPod marked it `unhealthy`).
.gitattributes added at repo root to force LF on *.sh / Dockerfile so the bug cannot recur.
notes: ttl.sh image expires automatically after 24h. Push to your own registry (GHCR/DockerHub/ECR) for production use — see deploy/DEPLOY.md.
GHA workflow file is staged at ci/docker-publish.yml.template. Activating it requires GitHub OAuth `workflow` scope which the assistant token did not have; activation instructions in ci/README.md.
workersMax was bumped from 1 to 2 mid-deploy because the first attempted worker pod (running the buggy CRLF image) stayed in `unhealthy` state and blocked scale-up of a fresh pod.
